heading: Wednesday, February 5, 2025
topLine: AlphaGeometry2 reported to surpass average gold medallist on olympiad geometry. Also: Google expands Gemini 2.0 with Pro Experimental and Flash-Lite.

items.headline: AlphaGeometry2 reported to surpass average gold medallist on olympiad geometry
items.summary: Google DeepMind researchers reported that AlphaGeometry2 solves 84% of IMO geometry problems from the last 25 years, up from 54% for the original AlphaGeometry, and said it surpasses an average gold medallist. These are the authors' own figures on historical problems.

items.headline: Google expands Gemini 2.0 with Pro Experimental and Flash-Lite
items.summary: Google made Gemini 2.0 Flash generally available and released Gemini 2.0 Pro Experimental, its strongest model at the time for coding, with a 2-million-token context window. It also released Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite in public preview as its most cost-efficient model.
